name: Haus Alpenrose
beschreibung:
Quietly perched on a sunny forest edge in Scheffau, Haus Alpenrose welcomes travellers with cosy rooms and attentive hospitality facing the dramatic peaks of the Wilder Kaiser.

The Scheffau cable car, Lake Hintersteiner See, and mountain trails are reached in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Alpenrose in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser provides peaceful relaxation and warm family comfort.
